prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1239; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center and the right taillight assembly is broken, with scuffing and a bent reinforcement bar behind the cover. This damage lines up with the impact as it was described, and the pattern of crush and transfer shows no sign of a separate event. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from our records or from the inspection itself. The invoices submitted contain no repeated charges, and the labor hours requested fit the scope of the repair: replace the bumper cover, reinforcement bar, and taillight, then refinish and recalibrate the parking sensors. I recommend approval of the estimate as presented.
